title: ee.global_promotion.backflow.v1
description: Feedback-backflow report for ee memory outcome-global: helpful/harmful feedback recorded on a user-global memory, with a clamped confidence adjustment flowed back to the origin workspace row when the global row carries ee-mem:// promotion provenance. Directly-authored global rows (ee remember --global) record feedback with no origin to adjust.

appliedDelta.description: Signed confidence adjustment applied to the origin row; magnitude clamped to the engine's per-event cap (0.05).
